action.message:
Nebu was installed successfully as a local Docker Compose development stack at /workspace (commit a4539d3). All services became healthy and the Matrix API, admin UI, Dex OIDC provider, PostgreSQL, MinIO and ClamAV are reachable.

Method used (per the guide's Docker-only workflow):
1. Installed the missing `make` prerequisite via apt (`GNU Make 4.3`); Docker 29.7.2 + Compose v5.5.0 were preinstalled.
2. `make setup` — generated `.secrets/internal_secret` and the MinIO credential files.
3. `docker compose build server` — built the `nebu-server:latest` image from `server/Dockerfile`.
4. `docker compose up -d` — started postgres, dex, minio, createbuckets, clamav, server.
5. Added the one-time `/etc/hosts` entry (`127.0.0.1 dex`).

Documentation deviation / workaround: the pinned images `minio/minio:RELEASE.2025-09-07T16-13-09Z` and `minio/mc:RELEASE.2025-08-13T08-35-41Z` no longer exist in the registry (`pull access denied`/404; the Docker Hub `minio/*` repos have been removed). A `docker-compose.override.yml` substitutes the Rancher mirrors `rancher/mirrored-minio-minio:RELEASE.2023-07-07T07-13-57Z` and `rancher/mirrored-minio-mc:RELEASE.2023-06-28T21-54-17Z`, which work with the bucket/IAM init container.

Verified state:
- All five long-running containers `Up (healthy)`; createbuckets exited 0.
- `GET http://localhost:4000/health` → 200.
- `GET http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/versions` → Matrix v1.1–v1.11.
- `GET http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/login` → SSO/OIDC and m.login.token flows.
- `GET http://localhost:8080/admin` → 302 → `/admin/bootstrap`, rendering "Bootstrap · Nebu Admin".
- `GET http://localhost:5556/dex/.well-known/openid-configuration` → 200.
- 34 DB migrations applied; MinIO bucket `nebu-media` created and `nebu-app-policy` attached.

The OIDC Bootstrap Wizard was intentionally left uncompleted (requires interactive browser login via Dex). The guide's expected log line `Nebu.Application started` does not literally appear; the equivalent readiness signal is the Bandit listener start plus passing `/health`.

3. `docker compose build server` — built `nebu-server:latest` (Node 20 assets stage, Elixir 1.20 release, Alpine 3.23 runtime running `Nebu.Release.migrate()` then `./bin/nebu start`).

### Final method vs abandoned attempts
Final method = supported `make setup` + `docker compose up`. The one abandoned attempt was an initial `docker compose up -d --build` that failed at image pull because guide-pinned `minio/minio` and `minio/mc` tags no longer exist in any reachable registry. Recovery: added `docker-compose.override.yml` mapping those two services to Rancher mirror images.

- `docker compose ps`: nebu-server-1, nebu-postgres-1, nebu-dex-1, nebu-minio-1, nebu-clamav-1 all `Up (healthy)`; nebu-createbuckets-1 exit 0.

- PostgreSQL: 34 migrations, ~38 tables owned by `nebu_migrate`.
- MinIO: bucket `nebu-media`, policy `nebu-app-policy` attached to app IAM user.

### Access points / commands
- Matrix API/media http://localhost:8008; Admin UI http://localhost:8080/admin (302 → /admin/bootstrap); health http://localhost:4000/health; Dex http://localhost:5556/dex; MinIO console http://localhost:9001; Postgres localhost:5432 (nebu/nebu).
- Start/stop: `cd /workspace && docker compose up -d` / `docker compose down`.

- Browser-only flows (Element SSO login, room creation) not exercised.
